series_item.title: Sketchbook Kitchen: illustrated cookbooks by BenizTor
series_item.description: Recipes in grams, drawn in watercolor. Free recipes and all the books at beniztor.com.

pins.title: Brown Butter Chocolate Chunk
pins.description: Browning the butter turns it nutty and deep, like toffee. Chopped bar chocolate melts into puddles that bagged chips never will. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Vanilla Bean
pins.description: The cupcake everything else is measured against: a tender, buttery crumb and a cloud of vanilla buttercream. Use a real vanilla pod if you can. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Linzer Cookies
pins.description: Buttery almond and cinnamon cookies sandwiched with raspberry jam and dusted with snow. A classic from Austria. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Nan-e Nokhodchi (Chickpea Flour Cookies)
pins.description: Tiny clover-shaped cookies of roasted chickpea flour and cardamom that dissolve on the tongue. No Nowruz tray is complete without them. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Classic Chocolate Chip
pins.description: The everyday cookie: crisp at the rim, soft in the middle, quick enough to make on a weeknight. Creaming the butter gives it a lighter crumb. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Everyday Chocolate
pins.description: Moist, deeply chocolatey and made in one bowl. Hot coffee wakes up the cocoa without making it taste of coffee. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Pfeffernüsse
pins.description: Little German spice cookies with honey, black pepper and anise, dipped in a crackly white glaze. Better after a few days in the tin. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Nan-e Berenji (Rice Flour Cookies)
pins.description: Snow-white rice flour cookies scented with rosewater and cardamom, topped with poppy seeds. A speciality of Qazvin. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Double Chocolate
pins.description: Cocoa in the dough and two kinds of chocolate in the mix. Dutch-process cocoa gives the darkest colour and the smoothest taste. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Red Velvet
pins.description: A whisper of cocoa, a tang of buttermilk and that famous red, under a thick swirl of cream cheese frosting. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Spritz Butter Cookies
pins.description: Piped butter cookies in rings, swirls and stars. One dough, a cookie press and forty minutes to fill a tin. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Nan-e Badami (Almond Cookies)
pins.description: Chewy almond cookies with crisp edges, made with egg whites and no flour. Naturally gluten-free. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Oatmeal Raisin
pins.description: Plump raisins, a hint of cinnamon and nutmeg, and a chewy oat base. Soaking the raisins keeps them juicy in the oven. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Confetti Birthday
pins.description: Vanilla cake speckled with rainbow sprinkles and topped with a pale buttercream swirl. Instant birthday. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Walnut Apricot Rugelach
pins.description: Flaky cream cheese pastry rolled around apricot jam, cinnamon sugar and walnuts. Crescent-shaped and dangerously easy to eat. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Nan-e Gerdooyi (Walnut Cookies)
pins.description: Crisp-edged, chewy walnut cookies made with egg yolks. Simple, rich and a bakery classic. Get the full recipe free. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Snickerdoodle
pins.description: A soft, tangy sugar cookie rolled in cinnamon sugar. Cream of tartar gives the classic tang and crackled top. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Lemon
pins.description: Zest in the cake, juice in the frosting: sharp, sunny and one of the most-requested cupcakes in any bakery. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Orange Almond Florentines
pins.description: Lacy, chewy discs of caramelised almonds and orange peel with a chocolate back. Elegant and quicker than they look. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Shirini Keshmeshi (Raisin Cookies)
pins.description: Thin, crisp-edged butter cookies dotted with raisins. Every Iranian bakery sells them, and every child loves them. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Peanut Butter Crisscross
pins.description: The fork-pressed cookie from every grandmother's tin, rich with peanut butter and a sugar-crunch crust. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Carrot Cake
pins.description: Warm spice, grated carrot and toasted walnuts, finished with a generous cream cheese frosting. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Cranberry Pistachio Biscotti
pins.description: Twice-baked Italian cookies in Christmas colours. Crunchy, keeps for weeks, and made for dunking in coffee. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Nan-e Pesteh'i (Pistachio Cookies)
pins.description: Buttery pistachio shortbread rolled in chopped pistachios. The colour of spring. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Soft Sugar Cookie
pins.description: Pillowy, pale and buttery. A spoonful of sour cream keeps these tender for days, and a drop of almond extract makes people ask what's in them. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Black and White
pins.description: Dark chocolate cake with a snowy vanilla buttercream: the best of both, in one bite. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Stained Glass Cookies
pins.description: Butter cookie frames filled with melted hard candy that sets like coloured glass. Children love making them. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Nan-e Kermanshahi (Kermanshah Butter Cookies)
pins.description: Rich, golden butter cookies from western Iran, traditionally made with the region's famous ghee, finished with sesame. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Chewy Molasses Spice
pins.description: Dark, chewy and crackled, with ginger, cinnamon and a hint of clove. Coarse sugar on the outside gives each one a sparkle and a crunch. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Marble
pins.description: Swirls of vanilla and chocolate batter in every cupcake, so no two look alike. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Chocolate Peppermint Sandwiches
pins.description: Dark chocolate cookies with a cool peppermint cream and crushed candy canes rolled around the edge. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Koloocheh (Fuman Walnut Cookies)
pins.description: Stamped round cookies from the town of Fuman in Gilan, filled with cinnamon and walnut. Travellers on the road north stop for them warm. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Giant Walnut Chocolate Chunk
pins.description: Tall, craggy and gooey in the middle. Cold butter, a hot oven and heavy dough balls are what keep these cookies thick. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Double Chocolate Ganache
pins.description: Chocolate cake with melting chips inside, dipped in a glossy dark ganache. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Bûche de Noël
pins.description: A light chocolate sponge rolled around vanilla mascarpone cream and covered in ganache bark. The French Christmas log. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Zaban (Puff Pastry Tongues)
pins.description: Flaky tongue-shaped puff pastries from Qazvin, brushed with honey and rosewater and sprinkled with pistachio. A nostalgic Nowruz favourite. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Hazelnut-Stuffed Cocoa
pins.description: A dark cocoa cookie with a molten hazelnut spread centre. Freezing the filling first is what keeps it inside. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Mocha
pins.description: Coffee in the cake and espresso in the buttercream. For anyone who takes dessert with a double shot. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Eggnog Bundt Cake
pins.description: Nutmeg-scented butter cake made with eggnog, with an eggnog glaze dripping down the ridges. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Nan-e Khamei (Persian Cream Puffs)
pins.description: Small choux puffs filled with vanilla cream and dusted with sugar. The star of every Iranian birthday and party. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Triple Chocolate Fudge
pins.description: Half brownie, half cookie: shiny, crackled tops and a fudgy middle, studded with milk and white chocolate. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Salted Caramel Chocolate
pins.description: Chocolate cake with a spoonful of caramel hidden inside and a caramel buttercream on top. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Cranberry Orange Loaf
pins.description: A tender orange loaf studded with tart cranberries and finished with a sharp orange glaze. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Roulette (Persian Cream Roll)
pins.description: A soft sponge rolled around whipped cream and strawberries, sliced to show the spiral. A tea-party classic. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: White Chocolate Cranberry
pins.description: Tart cranberries, sweet white chocolate and a little orange zest. This one tastes like the holidays. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter
pins.description: Rich chocolate cake under a fluffy peanut butter frosting. Salty, sweet and impossible to eat just one. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Whole Clementine Almond Cake
pins.description: Boiled whole clementines blended into a moist, flourless almond cake. Naturally gluten-free and even better the next day. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Keyk-e Yazdi (Yazdi Cupcakes)
pins.description: Little yogurt cakes scented with cardamom and rosewater, from the desert city of Yazd. Soft, fragrant and unfrosted. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Brown Butter Toffee Pecan
pins.description: Brown butter, dark sugar, toffee bits and toasted pecans. Deep caramel in every bite, finished with a pinch of salt. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Mint Chocolate
pins.description: Cool peppermint buttercream, tinted the palest green, on a dark chocolate cake. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Sticky Toffee Pudding
pins.description: Soft date sponge drowned in toffee sauce. The British pudding that ends every winter feast. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Baklava Yazdi (Almond Pistachio Baklava)
pins.description: Layers of pastry and cardamom-spiced almonds and pistachios, soaked in saffron-rosewater syrup. Lighter and less sweet than its Turkish cousin. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Birthday Sprinkle
pins.description: A vanilla cookie loaded with rainbow sprinkles and a little white chocolate. It tastes like birthday cake batter. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Chocolate Raspberry
pins.description: Dark chocolate cake with a hidden raspberry jam centre and a pink raspberry buttercream. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Spiced Pear Upside-Down Cake
pins.description: Caramelised pear slices on a ginger and cinnamon cake. Turned out warm, it shines like stained glass. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Gata (Armenian Sweet Pastry)
pins.description: A flaky, buttery Armenian pastry, a favourite in the Armenian bakeries of Tehran and Tabriz, rolled around a sweet buttery crumb called khoriz and cut into thick slices. Perfect with tea or coffee. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Red Velvet
pins.description: Cocoa, a splash of vanilla and a deep red colour, with white chocolate standing in for cream cheese frosting. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Cookies and Cream
pins.description: Vanilla cake studded with chocolate sandwich cookies, a cookie hidden in the base and cookie crumbs in the frosting. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Light Christmas Fruit Cake
pins.description: A lighter, golden fruit cake full of orange, cherries and almonds, without the heaviness of the old-fashioned kind. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Persian Love Cake
pins.description: Almond cake perfumed with saffron, cardamom and rose, glazed and scattered with pistachios and rose petals. Made, the story goes, to win a prince's heart. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Espresso Dark Chocolate
pins.description: A grown-up cookie: dark chocolate and espresso with a bittersweet finish. Good with a cup of coffee. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Chocolate Hazelnut
pins.description: Chocolate cake crowned with a hazelnut chocolate spread frosting and a toasted hazelnut on top. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Chocolate Hazelnut Torte
pins.description: A dense, fudgy, flourless chocolate cake with toasted hazelnuts. Rich enough for a crowd in thin slices. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Keyk-e Gerdooyi (Walnut Cake)
pins.description: A light, nutty walnut sponge with a whisper of cinnamon. Almost flourless and very quick. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Lemon Poppy Seed
pins.description: A soft lemon cookie flecked with poppy seeds and brushed with a sharp lemon glaze. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Strawberries and Cream
pins.description: Vanilla cake with fresh strawberries baked in and a strawberry buttercream that tastes like summer. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Cinnamon Star Bread
pins.description: Layers of soft dough and cinnamon sugar, cut and twisted into a sixteen-point star. It looks like a showpiece and pulls apart like a treat. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Sholeh Zard (Saffron Rice Pudding)
pins.description: Golden rice pudding with saffron and rosewater, decorated with cinnamon patterns. Made in huge pots and shared with neighbours as nazri. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Orange Cardamom
pins.description: Orange zest and cardamom, with dark chocolate to ground them. A flavour pairing borrowed from Middle Eastern pastry. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Blueberry Lemon
pins.description: Bursting blueberries in a lemon-scented cake, topped with a lemon cream cheese frosting. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Mini Stollen
pins.description: Buttery German Christmas bread with rum-soaked fruit and a rope of marzipan, buried under powdered sugar. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Fereni (Rice Flour Milk Pudding)
pins.description: Silky milk pudding thickened with rice flour and scented with rosewater. Gentle, simple and loved by children. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Raspberry White Chocolate
pins.description: Freeze-dried raspberries give real fruit flavour and a pink ripple without adding water to the dough. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Raspberry White Chocolate
pins.description: Pockets of tart raspberry and sweet white chocolate under a pale pink swirl. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Swedish Cardamom Knots
pins.description: Soft buns knotted around cardamom butter and topped with pearl sugar. The smell alone is worth making them. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Halva (Saffron Rosewater Halva)
pins.description: Flour toasted slowly in butter and mixed with saffron-rose syrup. The sweet served at memorials and religious gatherings. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Coconut Lime
pins.description: A chewy cookie full of toasted coconut with lime zest all the way through. Bright and tropical. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Coconut Lime
pins.description: Coconut milk and lime zest in the cake, toasted coconut on top. A holiday in a paper case. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Saffron Buns
pins.description: Golden S-shaped buns scented with saffron, baked across Sweden for Saint Lucia's day. Saffron's warmth in a soft, sweet bread. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Yakh dar Behesht (Ice in Paradise)
pins.description: A cool, trembling rosewater milk pudding whose name means 'ice in paradise'. Perfect for summer. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Apricot Almond
pins.description: Chewy dried apricots, almond extract and toasted sliced almonds. An old-fashioned combination that still works. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Banana Brown Sugar
pins.description: Soft banana cake with a brown sugar buttercream that tastes like caramel. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Christmas Morning Cinnamon Rolls
pins.description: Shaped the night before, baked while the presents are opened. Soft rolls with cream cheese icing. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Sheer Berenj (Creamy Rice Pudding)
pins.description: Soft rice cooked slowly in milk, flavoured with rose and cardamom and served with date syrup or jam. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Cherry Chocolate
pins.description: Tart dried cherries in a chocolate dough. The same pairing as Black Forest cake, in a cookie. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Apple Cinnamon
pins.description: Tender apple pieces and warm cinnamon, like apple pie in cupcake form, under a cinnamon cream cheese frosting. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Almond Braided Wreath
pins.description: A braided ring of sweet dough filled with almond cream and glazed. The centrepiece of the holiday breakfast table. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Ranginak (Date and Walnut Squares)
pins.description: Soft dates stuffed with walnuts, covered with flour toasted in butter and dusted with cinnamon and pistachio. A speciality of the south. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Strawberry Shortcake
pins.description: A buttery vanilla cookie with crushed freeze-dried strawberries and white chocolate, finished with a crunch of coarse sugar. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Cherry Almond
pins.description: Almond-scented cake with juicy cherries, topped with almond buttercream and a whole cherry. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Garlic Herb Pull-Apart Wreath
pins.description: A savoury party bread of buttery garlic and herb rolls baked together in a ring. Set it out and watch it vanish. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Masghati (Saffron Starch Sweet)
pins.description: A glossy, jelly-like sweet from Shiraz and Lar, made with starch, saffron and rosewater and studded with nuts. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Banana Bread
pins.description: Everything you love about banana bread in a soft cookie, with cinnamon, walnuts and a few chocolate chips. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Orange Blossom
pins.description: Orange zest in the cake and a hint of orange blossom water in the buttercream: fragrant and elegant. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Cranberry Walnut Soda Bread
pins.description: No yeast, no rising, no kneading. A crusty loaf on the table in under an hour, full of cranberries and walnuts. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Kachi (Saffron Flour Pudding)
pins.description: A warm, spoonable cousin of halva, traditionally made for new mothers and on cold winter nights. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Chai Spice
pins.description: Cinnamon, cardamom, ginger, clove and a pinch of black pepper: the flavour of masala chai in a soft, sugar-rolled cookie. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Chai Spice
pins.description: The flavours of masala chai baked into a soft cake, with a cinnamon buttercream on top. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Classic Pecan Pie
pins.description: Gooey brown sugar filling under a crown of toasted pecans, in a flaky butter crust. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Bamieh (Syrup-Soaked Choux)
pins.description: Crisp ridged fritters dipped in saffron-rose syrup. The sweet of Ramadan evenings, eaten with zoolbia. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Maple Pecan
pins.description: Real maple syrup in the dough and in the glaze, with toasted pecans. A cookie from the sugar-shack season. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Pumpkin Spice
pins.description: Moist pumpkin cake scented with autumn spice and topped with a maple cream cheese frosting. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Spiced Pumpkin Pie
pins.description: Silky, warmly spiced pumpkin custard in a crisp crust. The Thanksgiving pie that stays for Christmas. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Zoolbia (Lacy Saffron Spirals)
pins.description: Crisp, lacy fried spirals soaked in saffron syrup. Made in every bakery in the weeks of Ramadan. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Pistachio Rose
pins.description: Ground and chopped pistachios, a breath of rose water and crushed rose petals: a Persian pastry-shop flavour in cookie form. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Gingerbread
pins.description: Dark, sticky gingerbread cake with molasses and spice, under a tangy lemon cream cheese frosting. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Mince Pies
pins.description: Small, buttery pies of spiced fruit mincemeat, topped with pastry stars. A British Christmas essential. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Goosh-e Fil (Elephant Ears)
pins.description: Thin, crisp fried pastry pinched into ear shapes and dusted with cardamom sugar. Popular at Nowruz and weddings. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Saffron Cardamom Butter Cookies
pins.description: Small, tender butter cookies tinted gold with saffron and scented with cardamom, inspired by the cookies served with tea in Persian homes. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Maple Pecan
pins.description: Maple syrup in the cake and the frosting, toasted pecans throughout. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Pear Frangipane Tart
pins.description: Pear halves sunk into almond cream in a crisp sweet crust, glazed with apricot. Bakery-window elegant. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Nan-e Panjereh (Rosette Window Cookies)
pins.description: Crisp, lacy rosettes made with a patterned iron dipped in batter and fried. 'Panjereh' means window. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Vanilla Almond Crescents
pins.description: Crumbly almond crescents rolled in vanilla sugar while still warm. They melt the moment you bite in. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Pistachio Rose
pins.description: Ground pistachios in the cake and rose water in the buttercream, finished with crushed pistachios and rose petals. A Persian pastry-shop classic. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Chocolate Orange Tart
pins.description: A silky baked dark chocolate custard with orange zest in a crisp crust. Chocolate and orange, the holiday pairing. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Qottab (Almond-Filled Crescents)
pins.description: Fried crescent pastries filled with cardamom almonds and rolled in sugar. A specialty of Yazd. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Honey Tahini Sesame
pins.description: Nutty tahini and floral honey in a soft cookie with a toasted sesame crust. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Saffron Cardamom
pins.description: Golden saffron and fragrant cardamom, inspired by the cakes served with tea in Persian homes, under a pale saffron buttercream. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Cranberry Apple Crumble
pins.description: Tart apples and cranberries under a buttery oat crumble. The easiest pudding in the book, and one of the best. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Sohan Asali (Honey Almond Brittle)
pins.description: Crunchy golden discs of honey, saffron and almonds, topped with pistachio. A favourite from Isfahan. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Pumpkin Spice
pins.description: Chewy rather than cakey, thanks to blotted pumpkin and brown butter. Rolled in cinnamon sugar for autumn. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Honey Tahini
pins.description: Nutty tahini and floral honey in the cake and the frosting, with toasted sesame on top. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Panettone Bread and Butter Pudding
pins.description: Leftover panettone soaked in vanilla custard and baked until puffed and golden. The best use of a holiday gift. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Poolaki (Thin Sugar Coins)
pins.description: Paper-thin sugar coins, flavoured with saffron or sesame, served with tea as a sweetener. A speciality of Isfahan. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Gingerbread Cut-Outs
pins.description: Firm enough to cut into any shape, soft enough to enjoy eating. Decorate with the simple royal icing below. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Brown Butter Almond
pins.description: Almond cake finished with a nutty brown butter frosting and toasted almonds. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Eggnog Crème Brûlée
pins.description: Nutmeg-spiced baked custard under a shattering burnt-sugar top. Eggnog, but elegant. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Sohan-e Qom (Saffron Sohan)
pins.description: The famous brittle of Qom, made with sprouted wheat flour, saffron and butter, rich with pistachios and almonds. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

pins.title: Morning Oat & Seed
